requiredBehaviors.behavior: interrupt closure readiness and route the new safety event to jurisdiction-specific vigilance or MDR reassessment
requiredBehaviors.evidence: Material new safety events immediately reopen the safety pathway regardless of completion percentage.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: treat failure after correction as material evidence for risk CAPA and possible scope/action reassessment
requiredBehaviors.evidence: Post-correction recurrence feeds risk, CAPA and field-action scope/action reassessment.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: keep not-located units and unresolved disposition visible in closure readiness
requiredBehaviors.evidence: Not-located and unknown units remain explicit blockers or residual gaps.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: allow a target percentage to override a material new safety event
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: Percentage targets cannot suppress new material safety evidence.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: declare operational or authority closure while material units and repeat failure remain unresolved
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: Material unresolved safety/disposition states block closure readiness.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: use no-new-complaints before this event as evidence that the correction was effective
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: Absence of complaints is explicitly not an effectiveness proof.
